questions.text: What is the difference between a project and an app in Django?
questions.reference_answer: Project - The entire Django web application (settings, URLs, WSGI, etc.). App - A reusable module inside the project that handles specific functionality

Migrations are Django’s way of propagating model changes to the database schema.

questions.text: What is the difference between FBV and CBV?
questions.reference_answer: FBV → Simple functions, good for small or custom views; CBV → Class-based, reusable, supports mixins, good for CRUD-heavy apps

questions.text: What is the difference between forms.Form and forms.ModelForm?
questions.reference_answer: Form → Manual form fields, validation; ModelForm → Auto-generated fields from a model, simplifies saving
